in_hebrew.name: מַרְגִיָּה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Margie is derived from the Hebrew name Marge, which means 'lady of the magpie'. This name is not found in the Bible, but the biblical name Margaret, from which Margie is derived, means 'pearl' or 'gem' in Hebrew.

in_greek.name: Μαργαρίτη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Margie is derived from the Greek name Margaret, which means 'pearl' or 'gem'. This name is not found in the Bible, but the name Margaret is mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in the Book of Revelation (17:9).

in_latin.name: Margarita
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Margie is derived from the Latin name Margarita, which means 'pearl'. This name is not found in the Bible, but the name Margaret, from which Margie is derived, is mentioned in the Vulgate version of the Bible.
